benefits.name: First Checked Bag Free
benefits.description: First checked bag free on Delta-operated flights for the Card Member and up to eight companions on the same reservation.
benefits.terms: Applies to Delta-operated flights. Card must be used to purchase the ticket. Available to the Card Member and up to eight travel companions on the same reservation.

benefits.name: Zone 5 Priority Boarding
benefits.description: Main Cabin 1 (Zone 5) priority boarding on Delta-operated flights.
benefits.terms: Applies to Delta-operated flights when the Card Member is included on the reservation.

benefits.name: 20% Back on In-Flight Purchases
benefits.description: 20% savings, in the form of a statement credit, on eligible in-flight purchases of food, beverages and audio headsets on Delta-operated flights.
benefits.terms: Delivered as a statement credit after the purchase posts. Applies to eligible in-flight purchases on Delta-operated flights made with the Card.

earningRates.terms: Restaurants worldwide, including takeout and delivery in the U.S.
